Numbers produced after this commit.

tasks.query: wrap text into lines that fit a given width
tasks.note: Text.wrap divides the text into a Lines object no wider than the width, using divide_line per paragraph.

tasks.query: parse color string hex rgb ansi name into Color
tasks.note: Color.parse turns names, #rrggbb, rgb(...) and color(N) strings into Color objects.

tasks.query: export console recording as svg image
tasks.note: Console.export_svg renders recorded segments into an SVG document string.

tasks.query: guess pygments lexer from file name or code
tasks.note: Syntax.guess_lexer picks a lexer name from the path (and optionally the code).

tasks.query: add row of renderables to table
tasks.note: Table.add_row appends a row of renderables, creating columns when needed.

tasks.query: escape square brackets in markup string
tasks.note: markup.escape backslash-escapes tag-like square brackets.

tasks.query: split layout in to a row of side by side layouts
tasks.note: Layout.split_row splits the layout into a row of child layouts.

tasks.query: track progress over an iterable with progress bar
tasks.note: progress.track wraps an iterable and displays a progress bar while iterating.

tasks.query: pick unit and suffix for file size in bytes
tasks.note: filesize.pick_unit_and_suffix chooses the largest unit for a byte count.

tasks.query: highlight regex matches in text with style
tasks.note: Text.highlight_regex stylizes every match of a regular expression.

tasks.query: environment variables and tty checks deciding the palette depth at startup
tasks.note: Console._detect_color_system inspects jupyter, tty, dumb terminal, Windows features, COLORTERM and TERM to choose the color system.

tasks.query: turns bracketed tag notation inside a string into styled spans
tasks.note: markup.render parses [tag] notation and produces a Text with spans.

tasks.query: swap border glyphs for plain ascii ones on limited terminals
tasks.note: Box.substitute returns a legacy-Windows or ASCII replacement box when the terminal cannot draw the original.

tasks.query: emits escape codes that go back up over previously drawn lines and blank them so a dynamic display can repaint in place
tasks.note: LiveRender.position_cursor builds a Control that returns to the start of the last drawing and erases each line.

tasks.query: walks a raised error's chain of causes and contexts, collecting stack frames along with local variables
tasks.note: Traceback.extract builds a Trace of Stack/Frame objects following __cause__ and __context__.

tasks.query: animated loading indicator picks its frame sequence and interval from a lookup table by name
tasks.note: Spinner.__init__ looks up the named entry in SPINNERS and raises KeyError when unknown.

tasks.query: human friendly byte counts with kilo mega giga suffixes
tasks.note: filesize.decimal formats a byte count in SI (powers of 1000) units.

tasks.query: converts raw terminal escape codes embedded in a string back into styled output
tasks.note: AnsiDecoder.decode_line tokenizes SGR escape sequences into a Text with styles.

tasks.query: shrinks the widest fields first when a grid exceeds the screen width
tasks.note: Table._collapse_widths reduces the widest wrapable columns until the total fits max_width.

tasks.query: replaces indentation made of hard tab characters with spaces up to the next stop while keeping styled ranges aligned
tasks.note: Text.expand_tabs replaces tabs with spaces up to the next tab stop and adjusts spans.

tasks.query: print a string containing bracket tags until styled segments reach the output buffer
tasks.note: Console.print collects renderables, render_str calls markup.render to make a Text, and Text.__rich_console__ yields the segments.

tasks.query: log record to formatted table row with time level and source path
tasks.note: RichHandler.emit renders the message and calls LogRender to build the time/level/message/path row.

tasks.query: how an update to the dynamic display reaches the terminal, from refresh to the stored shape of the last drawing
tasks.note: Live.refresh hands the renderable to LiveRender and prints control codes plus the new segments.

tasks.query: negotiating how wide every column becomes between measured content and available space
tasks.note: _calculate_column_widths measures columns via _measure_column, which calls Measurement.get for each cell.

tasks.query: asking the user for typed input with validation and a default value
tasks.note: PromptBase.__call__ loops calling get_input, which delegates to Console.input.

tasks.query: showing a syntax highlighted source snippet inside an error report
tasks.note: Traceback._render_stack builds a Syntax for each frame and stylizes the error range.

tasks.query: wrapping text into lines while counting wide unicode glyphs by their terminal columns
tasks.note: Text.wrap uses divide_line, which measures words with cell_len and chops long words with chop_cells.

tasks.query: drawing one progress row for a task, from completed percentage to the colored bar
tasks.note: BarColumn.render builds a ProgressBar, whose __rich_console__ draws the bar segments.

tasks.query: splitting the screen into rectangular regions and rendering each child into lines
tasks.note: Layout._make_region_map assigns Region rectangles; Layout.render renders every leaf into lines for its region.

tasks.query: showing long output through the system viewer one screen at a time
tasks.note: Console.pager returns a PagerContext whose __exit__ sends the buffered content to Pager.show.
